column1: # Rename rules of the full rename (ADR-0007, spec 2026-10-06-005 §5 and §8).
# One rule per line, tab separated: kind, old, new, scope.
#   kind   path  - substring of a tracked file path, renamed with git mv
#          text  - fixed string in file content, replaced in place
#          guard - fixed string that must be gone before apply.sh runs
#                  (collisions fixed by hand, spec §8.2 rule 2); new is "-"
#   scope  comma separated globs on the (new) path; "*" is every file;
# Rules run in file order. Longer names come before their prefixes
# (§8.2 rule 1) and every case is a rule of its own (§8.2 rule 3).
# Strings and files that keep the old names are in keep.txt.
# --- Guards: collisions to resolve by hand first (§5.2, §5.6, D5, D9)
# The base-version key of v-list-sys-info is removed, ARCPANEL stays
# D9: Conflicts stays, Provides and Replaces go
# --- Paths: repository scripts with new names (§5.3)
# --- Paths: everything else keeps its shape (§5.1, §5.4, §5.5)
# Remaining hst- names: debug and upgrade logs, LXD container names
# --- Text: lower-case hst_ variables and PHP helpers (§5.2, §5.3)
# --- Text: the product name with the CP suffix, before the plain name
# --- Text: every other use, case kept (§5.2-§5.8). hestia-nginx,
# Hestia-Exit-Code all follow from these three rules.
